author: current Codex assistant
reasoning: A prime is a sum of two positive squares iff it is2 or congruent1 mod4. Sieve base primes to sqrt(r), then sieve only interval candidates congruent1 mod4; their multiples of each odd prime form stride p in compressed indices. Start at p^2 to retain prime itself. O((r-l)/4) bytes instead of a full 3e8-element integer sieve.
